items.title: Frank Strazzeri interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I took Tommy Flanagan’s place on that particular job... I had a lot of fun on that band.

ctx.x: I’m interested to see that you played with a good friend of Hamilton College, who is Joe Williams. I wondered how that came about and how you enjoyed your stint with him.
Oh it was great. I worked with Sweets Edison, he had a group behind Joe Williams. We worked out here in different places. I took Tommy Flanagan’s place on that particular © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-

job. And I liked it a lot. He was a great singer and a great guy too. I had a lot of fun on that band. That band had — Sweets Edison was the leader, a funny guy man. And the tenor player that wrote “Night Train.”
